from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
root=Path('PACKAGES')
rows=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    try:
        rel=p.relative_to(root)
        if len(rel.parts)>3: continue
        st=p.stat()
        rows.append((st.st_mtime,str(rel),p.is_dir(),st.st_size if p.is_file() else 0))
    except Exception: pass
rows.sort(reverse=True)
print('PACKAGES_EXISTS',root.is_dir())
print('ITEMS',len(rows))
for m,rel,isdir,size in rows[:500]:
    print(('DIR ' if isdir else 'FILE'),datetime.fromtimestamp(m).isoformat(timespec='seconds'),size,rel)
